module demo.model

import tinox.core.fs
import demo.model.Person

namespace demo.model
{
    /**
     * A documented class.
     */
    @Getter
    @Table("people")
    public class Person<T> extends Base implements Named, Comparable
    {
        readonly var id: Int64
        private const label: String = "none"
        var tags: List<String>
        var scores: Map<String, Float64>

        static fnc create(id: Int64) -> Person<Int64>
        {
            return Person { id: id, label: "x" }
        }

        async fn load(path: String) -> Nothing throws String
        {
            const text = await Fs::readFile(path)
            this.label = text
            self.id = 1
        }
    }

    interface Named
    {
        fn name() -> String
    }

    enum Color
    {
        Red
        Green
    }

    immutable Point(x: Float64, y: Float64)

    extern fn getpid() -> Int64
}
